name: PAY_FLOWS
description: this will be utilized in Payrollflow s

columns.name: FLOW_ID
columns.description: This column is the primary key of the table pay_flows.

columns.name: MT_WITHOUT_SOA_FLAG
columns.description: This column contains the SOA flag value of the flow.

columns.name: TASK_VERSIONING_ENABLED
columns.description: This column contains the task versioning enabled value of the flow.

columns.name: BASE_FLOW_ID
columns.description: This column contains the base flow id value of the flow.

columns.name: BASE_FLOW_NAME
columns.description: This column contains the base flow name value of the flow.

columns.name: DEFAULT_FLOW_FLAG
columns.description: This column contains the default flow flag value of the flow.

columns.name: LDG_RQD_FLAG
columns.description: This column contains the ldg required flag value of the flow.

columns.name: LEGISLATIVE_DATA_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to PER_LEGISLATIVE_DATA_GROUPS.

columns.name: LEGISLATION_CODE
columns.description: Foreign key to FND_TERRITORIES.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to PER_ENTERPRISES.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: FORMULA_ID
columns.description: This column contains the formula id value of the flow.

columns.name: START_SCH_TIME_DEF_ID
columns.description: Time definition id which defaults the start schedule of the corresponding flow instance.

columns.name: START_SCH_FORMULA_ID
columns.description: A Formula Id which will be used to default the formulaId present to the user during flow submission

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: CONNECTOR_TAG
columns.description: This column contains the connector tag value of the flow.

columns.name: CONNECTOR_STATUS
columns.description: This column contains the connector status value of the flow.

columns.name: FLOW_TYPE
columns.description: This column contains the flow type value of the flow.

columns.name: TASK_TYPES
columns.description: This column contains the task type value of the flow.

columns.name: OUTBOUND_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: This column contains the outbound enabled flag value of the flow.

columns.name: TASK_COUNT
columns.description: This column contains the task count value of the flow.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: IMPL_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: This column contains the impl class code value of the flow.

columns.name: SETUP_RULES
columns.description: This column contains the setup rules value of the flow.
